title: Formalize synthesis and delta runbook
description: Repo-review has two workflow gaps. A useful synthesis artifact exists between the First Read and Trace stages, but it is not an official pass and therefore uses an informal shape that downstream tools cannot consume cleanly. Delta Review also needs a formal local-agent runbook so users can execute `06-delta-review.md` by reference, deriving refs and focused evidence from local files and git rather than pasting large prompt bundles.
design: Keep synthesis as an optional interstitial pass named `02.5-synthesis.md`, not as a final `07` pass. Add a separate `DELTA_REVIEW_RUNBOOK.md` that is explicitly an execution harness, not an analytical pass. Update README, schema, prompt validation, tests, and Delta Review references so the workflow is coherent.
acceptance_criteria:
- The repo contains no `07-synthesis.md`.
- Official synthesis is represented as optional `02.5-synthesis.md` with `pass_id: synthesis`.
- A delta-review runbook exists as `DELTA_REVIEW_RUNBOOK.md`.
- Existing validator commands pass.
- All child tasks are closed.
close_reason: Completed synthesis/runbook plan: added 02.5-synthesis.md, DELTA_REVIEW_RUNBOOK.md, docs/schema/linter/test updates, and delta-review synthesis handling; validation passed.

Use `pass_id: synthesis`, prerequisites `first-read` and `discounted-artifact`, and output kind `prose-with-yaml-appendix`. title: Closing-discipline improvements for repo-review prompt series
description:
The repo-review prompt series (passes 01 through 05) has a failure mode: a later
pass notices a likely-important unread file, names it in confidence prose, then
continues the sequence without ever opening it. The target failure is not failure
to *notice* evidence — it is failure to *close* on evidence already noticed.

This effort narrowly strengthens closing discipline: (1) add a Coverage Closure
step to passes 03/04/05 that forces opening the prior blind spot most likely to
change the current thesis before the pass's main work; (2) add a concrete
`confidence.smallest_open` target across the six in-scope passes alongside a
shorter, more concrete `blind_spots` note; (3) keep 01 fast and resist adding
discovery machinery. It deliberately does NOT turn the series into a heavier
compliance exercise.

In-scope files: 01-first-read.md, 02-discounted-artifact.md, 02.5-synthesis.md,
03-trace.md, 04-twin.md, 05-lift.md, STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_SCHEMA.md,
tools/lint_pass_templates.py, tests/fixtures/pass-template-lint/*, README.md.
Out of scope: 06-delta-review.md (unchanged).
acceptance_criteria:
- 03/04/05 each require a pre-analysis close on the prior blind spot most likely to change the current thesis.
- 01 remains a fast first-impression pass, not a mandatory inventory or weak sibling-file advisory pass.
- Every in-scope pass carries `confidence.smallest_open`.
- Blind-spots prose still exists, in shorter and more concrete form.
- No changes to 06-delta-review.md.
- No directory-inventory or broad falsifiability schema machinery introduced.
- Falsifiability appears only as a required prose check in 03.
- The template linter passes on the updated templates and fixtures.

title: Add smallest_open and coverage_closure to STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_SCHEMA.md
description:
The schema doc is the canonical source that both the pass templates and the
validator follow, so it must be updated first (implementation order step 1). Two
small additions are needed and nothing more.
design:
Edit `STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_SCHEMA.md`.

1. Add `confidence.smallest_open` — applies to all six passes (01, 02, 02.5, 03, 04, 05). Shape:

```yaml
confidence:
  overall: <high | medium | low>
  blind_spots: |
    <short paragraph>
  smallest_open:
    path: <repo-relative path>
    why_this_open: <one sentence>
    defer_to_pass: <pass_id | null>
```

Document that it is a routing aid and a deferment commitment, not proof the file
was later opened; `defer_to_pass` may be `null` only when the analyzer expects to
open the file in the current pass; if deferred, a target pass must be named
(deferment to nowhere is disallowed by the wording even though the validator
cannot prove intent).

2. Add top-level `coverage_closure` — applies only to 03, 04, 05. Shape:

```yaml
coverage_closure:
  chosen_from_pass: <first-read | discounted-artifact | synthesis | trace | twin>
  path: <repo-relative path>
  why_this_was_most_thesis_threatening: <one sentence>
  finding: <one short paragraph>
  changed_prior_judgment: <true | false>
  shift_summary: <short | null>
```

Document that it is ONE chosen blind spot, not an array — the point is
prioritization (pick the one most likely to matter).

Explicitly do NOT add: `directory_inventories`; top-level `falsifiability`;
per-seed `falsifiability`; any new fields for 06-delta-review.md.
acceptance_criteria:
- `confidence.smallest_open` block documented with its three subfields and the null/defer rules.
- `coverage_closure` block documented with all six subfields, scoped to 03/04/05, noted as a single object not an array.
- No `directory_inventories` or `falsifiability` schema added.
close_reason: Added confidence.smallest_open (path/why_this_open/defer_to_pass) and coverage_closure (chosen_from_pass/path/why_this_was_most_thesis_threatening/finding/changed_prior_judgment/shift_summary, scoped to trace/twin/lift, single object) to STRUCTURED_OUTPUT_SCHEMA.md — commit 8bf05d0

title: Add Coverage Closure, smallest_open, and falsifiability prose to 03-trace.md
description:
03 is the most important file in the change set. It is where closing discipline
is first enforced as a required, separate step before the pass's main analytical
work.
design:
Edit `03-trace.md`.

1. Add a new Coverage Closure section BEFORE the existing pass logic:
- "Before tracing the obligation, open the previously named blind spot most likely to change the current thesis."
- Require the analyzer to state: which prior blind spot it chose; why that blind spot was the most thesis-threatening; what it found; whether the finding changes any prior judgment.
- Wording is load-bearing: the close is REQUIRED; it is SEPARATE from the trace's main analytical work; use the exact phrase "most likely to change the current thesis" — do NOT weaken it to "at least one prior blind spot".

2. Confidence section: add `confidence.smallest_open`.

3. Required prose-only falsifiability: in the verdict section, add one short line aimed at the highest-risk judgment: "What is the smallest piece of evidence that would flip your verdict on deferred-versus-abandoned, or on same-claim-versus-substitute? If you have not looked for it, look now."

YAML changes:
- Add top-level `coverage_closure` (shape per the schema doc).
- Do NOT add a top-level `falsifiability` schema block.
acceptance_criteria:
- Coverage Closure section present before the main pass logic, with the four required statements and the load-bearing "most likely to change the current thesis" + "separate from the main work" framing intact.
- `confidence.smallest_open` present.
